name: Shinshoku
source:
The protagonist has failed his college debut and has lost confidence in himself, unable to fulfill his goal of finding a girlfriend.
He is saved by his crush, Mishio Okina, when he is stripped naked by a gang of delinquents.
The protagonist, in despair at being seen in such a pathetic state, strongly wishes to disappear from Mishio's sight right away.
The next moment, Mishio somehow really loses sight of the protagonist, who is supposed to be right in front of her.

The protagonist realizes that he has a special power that allows him to interfere with other people's perceptions.
If he manipulates their sense of sight, they cannot see what he sees, if he manipulates their sense of hearing, they cannot hear what he hears, and if he manipulates their sense of touch, they don't even notice being touched.
The protagonist, who has learned that he can manipulate all perceptions, decides to use this ability, which he names "Perception Seizure," to his own degrading ends.

Peeping and home invasion are also at his disposal. ......
The days of lust begin as he invades the lives of women with his many lewd acts.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/snsk/prologue.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角大学首秀失败，对自己失去信心，无法实现找女朋友的目标。
当他被一帮罪犯剥光衣服时，他的暗恋对象冲名三潮救了他。
主角看到自己如此可怜的样子，感到绝望，强烈希望立即从三潮的视线中消失。
下一刻，三尾不知怎么就真的看不到主角了，而主角本应就在她面前。

主角意识到自己拥有一种特殊的能力，可以干扰他人的看法。
如果他操纵他们的视觉，他们就看不到他看到的东西；如果他操纵他们的听觉，他们就听不到他听到的东西；如果他操纵他们的触觉，他们甚至不会注意到被触摸。
主角了解到他可以操纵所有感知，决定使用这种能力，他将其命名为“感知癫痫”，以达到他自己的可耻目的。

偷窥和入室盗窃也都在他的掌控之中。……
当他用许多猥亵行为侵入妇女的生活时，欲望的日子就开始了。

[翻译自[url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/snsk/prologue.html]官网[/url]]
